finding: CBE corridor admission used boundingBoxReal model coordinates directly as world-metre support/body offsets and convoy dimensions. Active CROSS already transforms all hull corners with modelToWorldWorld. Lead admission, worst-follower envelope and shared path minimum dimensions could therefore disagree for non-unit scale.
implementation: DrivingCorridorGeometry reads finite positive object scale and scales raw low/high exactly once before width/height/tail-extension calculations. Existing world-metre convoy envelope and safety margins are not scaled again.

DrivingCorridorStep builds the worst envelope from each alive convoy hull in world metres, same <=20 roster. Invalid scale becomes an INVALID_ENVELOPE sentinel rather than a partial/lead-only envelope. Explicit loop flag prevents nested SQF exit scope from concealing a bad follower.

DrivingPathGeometry cannot shrink a supplied footprint below the current scaled vehicle width/height; unknown or >20m sampling dimensions refuse before casts. Existing larger caller radii remain conservative.

Existing actual-corner CROSS checks retain world transforms and never multiply those points again. No change to controller ownership, requests, native orders, clocks, physics, retries, clearance credit or completed task interpretation.

cost: One extra scale read per corridor hull; shared path validation adds one current bounding-box and scale observation per existing invocation. No extra world/ray query or recurring callback. Actual5%median/10%p95 overhead remains unmeasured.
